courses.title: Systems, beginner
courses.summary: A short course across FPS, third-person, horror, and strategy. The same rules, fewer pages than a program.

modules.title: Look without Tick
modules.takeaway: A timer looks. Tick keeps looking while you stand still. This is true for a rifle, a horror door, and a strategy unit.

quiz.prompt: What happens if the look trace moves onto Tick?
choices: It runs once in the constructor.
quiz.review_prompt: What does Tick do to a look trace?

diff.review_prompt: Which look check is the broken one?

modules.title: One interface
modules.takeaway: A door, a pickup, and a strategy crate can answer one interface. A cast list grows every time you add one.

assignment.prompt: What do you call instead of a cast?

quiz.prompt: What happens if you cast to every usable Blueprint?
choices: The list grows with every new actor.
quiz.why: A cast chain is the inefficient version.
quiz.review_prompt: What grows when you cast to every Blueprint?

diff.review_prompt: Which call is the broken one?
diff.why: The cast chain is the bug.

modules.title: Who writes the number
modules.takeaway: Health, ammo, and a strategy score are written with authority. The widget listens.

quiz.prompt: What happens if every client subtracts health?
choices: The server copy is the only one.
quiz.why: Clients asking is not clients deciding.
quiz.review_prompt: What happens when every client writes health?

diff.review_prompt: Which health line is the broken one?
diff.why: The bare subtract is the bug.

modules.title: The row owns the number
modules.takeaway: A weapon row, a horror item, and a strategy order can live in a data table. The widget does not invent the number.

assignment.prompt: Where does the designer edit the number?

quiz.prompt: What happens if the magazine size is hardcoded?
choices: The data table row is ignored.
quiz.why: A hardcoded number ignores the row.
quiz.review_prompt: What does a hardcoded magazine size ignore?

diff.review_prompt: Which magazine size is the broken one?
diff.why: The hardcoded size is the bug.

courses.title: Systems, intermediate
courses.summary: The same general mix, with C++ repairs and a question about what you would not replicate.

modules.title: What not to replicate
modules.takeaway: Replicate the number. Do not replicate the widget, the mesh, or a motion-matching pose.

assignment.prompt: Name one thing you should not replicate for a health bar.

quiz.prompt: What happens if you replicate the health widget?
choices: The bar stays correct and cheap.
quiz.why: The widget is rebuilt on each machine.
quiz.review_prompt: What is wrong with replicating the widget?

diff.review_prompt: Which replicated piece is the broken one?
diff.why: The widget property is the bug.

modules.title: A clamp that effects cannot skip
modules.takeaway: A 10% attribute ceiling belongs in C++. A gameplay effect can feed it. It should not replace it.

quiz.prompt: What happens if a gameplay effect writes past the clamp?
choices: The C++ clamp still applies if it runs after the effect.
The effect is allowed to ignore C++.
quiz.why: The clamp is the rule. The effect is an input.

diff.review_prompt: Which clamp is the broken one?
diff.why: Skipping the clamp is the bug.

modules.title: Slots and the equipped id
modules.takeaway: A gunsmith can have ten slots in a data asset. Replicate the equipped id. Do not replicate every attachment mesh.

assignment.prompt: What do you replicate for the gunsmith?

quiz.prompt: What happens if every attachment mesh is replicated?
choices: The bandwidth goes to meshes the client can rebuild.
The equipped id is not enough.
quiz.why: The client can build the mesh from the id.
quiz.review_prompt: Why not replicate every attachment mesh?

diff.review_prompt: Which gunsmith replicate is the broken one?
diff.why: Replicating the meshes is the bug.

modules.title: Repair the line
modules.takeaway: A broken graph uses Tick. A broken health line forgets authority. The repair is the smaller change that puts the rule back.

assignment.prompt: Which word is the health repair?

quiz.prompt: Which repair fixes a look trace that is on Tick?
quiz.review_prompt: What replaces Tick for a look trace?

diff.review_prompt: Which repair side is the broken one?
diff.why: The right side is still Tick.
